email.subject: Pearl Dentistry: two quick fixes worth finding
email.body:
Hi Kofi,

I checked Pearl Dentistry's site. Two things are likely costing you patients: there's no online booking, so anyone searching after hours has no way to grab a slot and probably calls a competitor instead. And there's no click-to-call on mobile, so someone has to manually dial your number instead of tapping it.

Also worth fixing: your footer looks outdated and your hours aren't listed anywhere, which makes people unsure if you're open before they even reach out.

Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd fix and why. No pitch, just the review.

Alex
